name: Xpro India Limited
summary: Xpro India Limited processes and sells polymers primarily in India. The company offers dielectric films for applications comprising power transmission and distribution, motor run, power film/electronic, magnetic lighting ballast, microwave oven, low voltage industrial power factor correction, AC and pulse film, interference suppression, and hybrid cars capacitors, as well as for energy storage applications.
